verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at getaleph.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an AI-oriented product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Its content covers spreadsheet sync, forecasting, headcount planning and connectors. However, it reads as a capability overview rather than deep technical documentation, and the markdown doc variants and OpenAPI specs all return 404. Missing for 10: markdown/agent-readable versions of doc pages, technical or API-level depth in the llms.txt, machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration of agent usage.
